reviews.rationale: EXP-004 H6 (TFE Entities). Approved: the patch reproduces 16 context lines and 2 deleted lines of structural code only, exported with 1 line of context; the RT entity hooks (flashlight, HUD, first-person weapon render) are functionally necessary for the ray-tracing backend.

EXP-004 G4. Approved: the retail TFE RenderingOptions.cfg receives only a single Include: line (1 line of context); the RT gadgets moved to an SSTRE-authored file with SPDX header and Serious-Engine-RT attribution.
